say:3:1120824001:1.text: Are you here to hand in the bounty?

choice_prompt:4:1120824001.text: Are you here to hand in the bounty?

say:5:1120824002:1.text: Please be patient as I verify its contents.
say:5:1120824002:1.source_cn: 标的物已收到，请待我查验。

say:7:1120824004:1.text: There's no mistaking it. Indeed, this is the venom of a Dark-Eyed Spider native to the Crimson Highlands.
say:7:1120824004:1.source_cn: ……检验无误。您确实取回了深红高原的诡蛛毒液。

say:9:1120824006:1.text: And so, the second requirement of the bounty includes...
say:9:1120824006:1.source_cn: 那么，第二个悬赏要求是——

say:10:1120824007:1.text: Wait a second! The bounty's been fulfilled! You got your venom! How's there another step?!
say:10:1120824007:1.source_cn: ——等等，执事老爷！之前的悬赏条件都满足了，怎么还有下...

say:11:1120824008:1.text: These are the requirements of Lord Pike. You'll only get the Dusk Eye after you complete all three trials.
say:11:1120824008:1.source_cn: 荒矛老爷的要求如此。等三项考验达成后，才能将残阳之眼给各位。

say:12:1120824009:1.text: Right... well, how do we know you really have the Dusk Eye?! Let us take a look at it first!
say:12:1120824009:1.source_cn: ……我说执事老爷，既然真有残阳之眼那种好东西，就先给我...

say:13:1120824010:1.text: I mean it's not against the rules, and it'll help keep us motivated! Lord Pike will appreciate that! Otherwise, it's hard to imagine somebody doing all three tasks without seeing any rewards...
say:13:1120824010:1.source_cn: 看看又没有违背荒矛老爷的规定，而且还能让接悬赏的人更有...

say:14:1120824011:0.text: As you wish... Behold, the Dusk Eye...
say:14:1120824011:0.source_cn: ……既然如此，请看。这就是残阳之眼。

say:19:1120824013:0.text: Yep... with that degree of transparency and crimson coloration... It really is the Dusk Eye...!
say:19:1120824013:0.source_cn: ……这种通透度和火彩，确实是残阳之眼没错啊……

say:20:1120824014:0.text: We have to do this job, Magister. It's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. If we miss this chance, I'll regret... I mean we'll regret it for the rest of our lives!
say:20:1120824014:0.male: We have to do this job, Magister. It's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. If we miss this chance, I'll regret... I mean we'll regret it for the rest of our lives!

say:22:1120824015:0.text: The second trial is to retrieve a <style="highlight">neutralizing agent to remedy the venom</style>!

say:25:1120824016:0.text: What?! First, you have us find you venom, and now you want the antidote? Is this some kind of joke?
say:25:1120824016:0.source_cn: 什、什么？！先让人找毒液，又让人找中和剂，这不是在逗人...

say:26:1120824017:0.text: Lord Pike's requirements are thus. I'm only following orders.
say:26:1120824017:0.source_cn: 荒矛老爷的要求如此，我听命而已。

say:27:1120824018:0.text: If it's a neutralizer, I've got you covered, Magister.
say:27:1120824018:0.male: If it's a neutralizer, I've got you covered, Magister.
say:27:1120824018:0.female: If it's a neutralizer, I've got you covered, Magister.
